description: Update a device's key settings, such as disabling key expiry. Useful for servers that should never need to re-authenticate.

deviceId.description: The device ID. nodeId from tailscale_list_devices (e.g. nPM2KNuedB21DEVEL); numeric id ok; not the nodeKey.

keyExpiryDisabled.description: Whether to disable key expiry for this device

name: tailscale_update_device_key
title: Update device key
